lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: A semi-regular grid of high-luminance circular pixel clusters arranged in approximately six horizontal rows and ten vertical columns across the visible mid-to-posterior lateral flank.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Faint vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity oriented perpendicular to the longitudinal axis, intersecting with the horizontal rows of high-luminance blobs to create a coordinate-like grid.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: A prominent horizontal feature characterized by a sharp vertical pixel intensity gradient (light upper, shadowed lower) situated in the superior third of the visible flank, extending towards the caudal peduncle.

dorsal_fin_surface_patterning.internal_spot_density: Approximately 12-15 discrete high-luminance pixel clusters of varying diameters distributed irregularly within the silhouette of the first dorsal fin, primarily concentrated in the ventral and posterior regions of the fin surface.
